answer: Here is one mechanism that works: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because pulse only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, willow is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any cipher approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
